juno.ref_prompt: Juno, a scruffy orange fox with a white-tipped tail, wearing a short blue scarf and round flight goggles pushed up on her forehead

shots.video_prompt: Juno sprints downhill, the camera tracking alongside as grass blurs past, no speech, no subtitles.

shots.frame_prompt: Juno leaps over a low stone wall, one paw stretched up toward the trailing kite string.
